review_mode: Read-only preflight already completed; this step only records that review as a new audit artifact.

scope.image_domain: Four full 640x480 RGB eyes per fixed frame; unchanged rig and signed bidirectional pairing.
scope.implementation: New float64 RGB BT/5x5 and three-path numerical reference; not OpenCV output equivalence or a single-factor patch of original OpenCV.
scope.arms: Both arms share the same evidence_decode consumer and actual unary support; only aggregation support mask on/off differs.
scope.GT_boundary: Predict reads RGB, archived CAD, estimated pose and origin. Numeric GT scoring follows a complete eight-output prediction seal and matching protocol SHA.
scope.scoring: Same fixed four-frame visible-height target, full pixel counts and original local gates. No denominator selection based on repaired outputs.
scope.source_helpers: Reuse archived source LR/depth/points helpers; original OpenCV matcher is not instantiated or invoked.

findings.timing_limitation: LR/depth/projection timing is now included separately and in the combined source sum. The without_IO field excludes prediction NPZ saving, but its first segment still contains progress writes; it is not a pure no-I/O measurement or actual online end-to-end latency.
findings.external_resource_requirement: Predict must run under externally enforced MemoryMax=8G (8 GiB) and MemorySwapMax=0. These are not implemented inside supervise.py; this preflight did not independently verify an active systemd unit.
findings.supervision: Predict timeout 900 seconds; other stages 90 seconds. No recovery allowance in this repaired ledger.

assessment: Eligible for one frozen-protocol predict dispatch after saved successful interfaces, subject to external memory/swap enforcement; this is not a completed source-output audit.

no_rerun.during_this_recording: No experiment, source, test, decoder, cost, aggregation or GT access was performed. Frozen source and protocol were not edited.

limits: No real RGB accuracy, coverage, obstacle, full-sequence, OpenCV-equivalence, calibrated confidence, map, navigation or online latency conclusion. Original fixture failure and its diagnosis remain preserved. Saved-output audit is pending the completed seal and scoring.
